scenes.say: There's a tax you pay every day. Nobody voted for it.
It's inflation. Your balance stays the same. What it buys shrinks.
Leave {cash_start} in cash, losing about {cash_rate} of buying power a year.
scenes.note: Assumption: cash loses {cash_rate}/yr of buying power; savings earn {sav_rate} above inflation

scenes.say: After {years} years, it buys what about {cash_end} buys today.
scenes.big_label: of buying power left after {years} years

scenes.say: Doing nothing felt safe. It was a decision, and it had a price.
The real question isn't how much interest you earn. It's whether it beats inflation.
Your money is either working, or it's quietly melting.

takeaway: Your money is either working, or it's quietly melting.
